top_story.headline: Two sitting House members still have no 2025 annual financial disclosure on file, 64 days past their final extensions
top_story.dek: Rep. Michael T. McCaul and Rep. Dan Crenshaw, both of Texas, filed extension requests this spring and have not filed since.
paragraphs: Rep. Michael T. McCaul (R-TX-10) filed an extension request on 4/29/2026. Rep. Dan Crenshaw (R-TX-2) filed one on 6/4/2026. The final extension date for both was 8/13/2026, and neither has a CY2025 annual financial disclosure on file, now 64 days past that date. The finding comes from a check of every sitting member's filings in the Clerk of the House index and Senate eFD.
The script behind the finding warns that a filing under an unexpected spelling of a name can read as missing. Members sworn in after Nov. 1 of the report year owe no annual report and were excluded.

Separately, the Ethics Agreement Tracker lists seven Senate-confirmed officials with no posted certification of ethics-agreement compliance, more than 30 days past deadline. The longest overdue is Michelle White Bowman, Governor and Vice Chairman for Supervision of the Federal Reserve System Board of Governors, confirmed 6/4/2025 with a certification due 9/2/2025, 409 days ago.

sections.eyebrow: Contacts With the President, VP & Cabinet
sections.headline: No logged communications with the President, VP or cabinet; four LDA filings name them
paragraphs: Two FARA filings flagged by the top-official scan, both informational materials filed by Friends of Sinn Fein, Inc., only quote press coverage of President Donald Trump's remarks on Irish unity. Neither logs a communication with him, so both are set aside. Eleven recent FARA filings were not yet read because of the time budget and will be read in the next run. Four LDA third-quarter reports name the President or Vice President as an entity lobbied.

items: Anchor & Arrow LLC for American Phalanx: lists the Office of the Vice President among entities lobbied, on defense acquisition policy reform, defense innovation, American technology leadership and maritime domain awareness. Filing.

Catholic Health Association of the United States (in-house): lists the President among entities lobbied, on H.R. 1144 (Frederick Douglass Trafficking Victims Prevention Protection and Reauthorization Act of 2025) and H.R. 529 (Protecting Sensitive Locations Act). Filing.

Shield AI (in-house): lists the Vice President among entities lobbied, on the National Defense Authorization Act, defense appropriations, autonomy and artificial intelligence, FAA regulations and foreign military sales. Filing.
Squire Patton Boggs for Hyperion Materials and Technologies: lists the Vice President among entities lobbied, on critical minerals and metals. Filing.

sections.headline: Six New Ethics Filings from Federal Appointees
paragraphs: Six new ethics filings have been posted in the OGE database from recent presidential appointees. The filings include compliance certifications and ethics agreements addressing resignations and recusal obligations, along with Deputy Secretary Stephen Feinberg's annual financial disclosure.

items: David Brat, Ambassador to Australia at the Department of State — Certification of Ethics Agreement Compliance. The certification confirms that Brat completed all required divestitures indicated in his ethics agreement and filed a periodic transaction report (dated 10/2/26) documenting the completion.
Nick Oberheiden, Ambassador to Egypt (Arab Republic of) at the Department of State — Ethics Agreement. Only the fact of the filing is confirmed; the document text is not readable.
Brien Lorenze, Commissioner at the Consumer Product Safety Commission — Certification of Ethics Agreement Compliance. Lorenze signed the certification on October 14, 2026.

James R. Jackson, U.S. Marshal for the Eastern District of Texas at the Department of Justice — Ethics Agreement. The agreement outlines Jackson's commitment to resign from his position with the Smith's County Sheriff's Office, maintain recusal obligations regarding his spouse's employment with the Troup Independent School District, and complete other required resignations.

Reid M. Creswell, U.S. Marshal for the District of South Carolina at the Department of Justice — Ethics Agreement. The agreement outlines Creswell's commitment to resign from his position with the South Carolina Law Enforcement Division and maintain recusal obligations regarding his spouse's employment with the South Carolina Retirement System Investment Commission.

Stephen Feinberg, Deputy Secretary at the Department of Defense — Annual (2026) Public Financial Disclosure Report. The disclosure documents positions Feinberg held outside government before taking office in March 2025, which he divested upon assuming his role.

sections.headline: 23 new registrations, 45 terminations, and a quarter-end wave of third-quarter reports
paragraphs: The 750 filings listed since 2026-10-15 break down as follows. There were 578 third-quarter reports and 80 no-activity third-quarter reports. There were 23 registrations, 44 terminations by filing type and one report carrying a termination date. The rest were amendments and a handful of second-quarter and first-quarter filings. The listing stopped after 30 pages, so more filings exist than are counted here.

The tables cover every registration and every termination with reported activity. Another 23 terminations were no-activity filings. Among activity reports, only eight of the 334 flagged with a signal are shown, and 348 more carried no signal and are only counted. Several firms put former congressional and executive-branch staff on the new registrations.

blocks.text: Tracking 483 Senate-confirmed officials with ethics agreements since Jan. 20, 2025. Deadlines are counted from the confirmation date on congress.gov plus the agreement's stated window (usually 90 days) -- OGE can grant extensions that aren't public, so treat each flag as a lead to confirm, not a finding. OGE posts certifications with a lag, so nothing inside 30 days of a deadline is flagged. A certification filed but not yet posted by OGE will read as missing: confirm with the agency before publishing.
